description: Lists the domains in the connected CookiePal account that this user can see, with each domain’s plan, this month’s page views, whether its page-view limit has been reached, and whether its banner has been found installed. Plans are per domain.
name: list_domains

bannerVerificationStatus.description: Whether the CookiePal banner has been found installed on the site.

pageViewLimitReached.description: True when this month’s page views have reached the plan’s limit.

plan.description: The domain’s plan. Plans are per domain, not per account.

title: List CookiePal domains
